source: A4 Le témoin de la domestique
lieu: kitchen of a nice house in Cocody, Abidjan, a white chest freezer with its lid open and empty inside, a small kitchen table, evening

persos.nom: the furious wife at the freezer
persos.desc: wife in her 40s, wine-red satin house robe, short curly hair, holding the freezer lid open
persos.pose: standing next to the open empty freezer, pointing inside it, furious

persos.desc: young housemaid in her 20s, lilac housekeeper dress with a white collar, hair in a neat bun
persos.pose: standing in front of the wife, one hand on her heart, sincere

persos.desc: husband in his 40s, round glasses, sand-coloured safari jacket, holding his phone
persos.pose: sitting at the small kitchen table in the right background, looking at his phone

dialogue: Qui a mangé le poulet que j'ai caché dans le congélateur-là ?!
Madame, je jure c'est pas moi dêh. Patron et moi on était à Bassam toute la journée.
jeu: Nobody walks; all three stay in their places for the whole video. The husband keeps looking at his phone silently. The wife shouts, pointing inside the empty freezer. The housemaid answers sincerely, one hand on her heart, her face clearly visible.
chute: The housemaid and the wife stay exactly where they are. The wife slowly turns her head toward her husband, who stays seated at the same table and slowly lowers his phone. The camera slowly pushes in across the kitchen to a close-up of the seated husband's busted face looking into the camera.

source: B1 La porte de la douche
lieu: living room of a house in Abobo, Abidjan, at night, a wide open window with curtains moving in the wind, an old TV still on its stand, a ceiling lamp

persos.nom: the amazed boy in the dinosaur pyjamas
persos.desc: boy around 9, green pyjamas with little dinosaurs
persos.pose: standing in the middle of the room, pointing at the open window, amazed

persos.desc: father in his 40s, white sleeveless vest, checkered brown sarong around his waist
persos.pose: standing on the right, hands on his hips

persos.desc: mother in her 40s, very short natural hair, long yellow nightgown, holding a long straight wig in her hand
persos.pose: standing in the doorway on the left, holding her wig

dialogue: Papa, le voleur a laissé la télé et il a sauté par la fenêtre dêh !
Chérie, je t'ai dit de pas te promener la nuit sans ta perruque. Voilà, tu as traumatisé l'enfant d'autrui !
jeu: Nobody walks; all three stay in their places for the whole video. The boy points at the open window, amazed. The father turns his head toward the mother and scolds her, his face clearly visible. The mother listens silently, holding her wig.
chute: Nobody moves: the mother stays in the doorway on the left and freezes, hugging her wig against her chest. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the mother's offended face looking into the camera.

lieu: small wooden table in a modest house in Koumassi, Abidjan, one bowl of rice with a little sauce, a kerosene lamp, evening

persos.nom: the amazed boy with the spoon
persos.desc: boy around 8, faded red t-shirt with a white star, holding a spoon with a tiny piece of meat on it
persos.pose: sitting at the table, staring at the tiny piece of meat on his spoon, amazed

persos.desc: thin father in his 40s, grey stubble, old brown work overalls
persos.pose: sitting across the table, tired, eating plain rice

dialogue: Papa ! Il y a la viande dans ma sauce dêh !
Mange vite avant de te réveiller.
jeu: Nobody walks; both stay in their places for the whole video. The boy shouts with joy, raising his spoon with the tiny piece of meat. The father answers calmly and seriously, his face clearly visible.
chute: The boy freezes with the spoon in the air, then quickly looks at the meat. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the boy's shocked face looking into the camera.

lieu: bedroom of a family house in Marcory, Abidjan, a mirror on a dressing table, a bed with a colorful bedspread, afternoon light

persos.nom: the proud teenage girl at the mirror
persos.desc: teenage girl around 15, white-and-blue striped t-shirt, big curly afro with a yellow headband
persos.pose: standing in front of the mirror, admiring herself, then turning to her mother

persos.nom: the tired mother on the bed
persos.desc: tired mother in her 40s, faded green headscarf, plain grey house dress, folding laundry
persos.pose: sitting on the bed, folding laundry

dialogue: Maman, j'ai pris ma beauté de qui ?
Ahh… C'est pour ça toi tu as plus rien dêh.
jeu: Nobody walks; both stay in their places for the whole video. The girl admires herself in the mirror, then turns her face toward her mother and asks. The mother answers proudly while folding laundry. The girl looks at her mother up and down and answers innocently, her face clearly visible.
chute: The mother freezes with the laundry in her hands. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the mother's offended face looking into the camera.

lieu: small clinic consultation room in Adjamé, Abidjan, a weighing scale, a desk with papers, health posters without text, morning

persos.nom: the plump aunt in the flowered dress
persos.desc: plump aunt in her 40s, huge flowered fuchsia-and-orange dress, a small handbag on her knees
persos.pose: sitting in front of the desk, hopeful

persos.desc: calm doctor in his 50s, grey beard, white coat over a lavender shirt, stethoscope around his neck

dialogue: Docteur, je veux maigrir vite dêh !
Tantie, marie un chômeur dêh. C'est le régime le plus rapide d'Abidjan.
jeu: Nobody walks; both stay in their places for the whole video. The aunt asks with hope. The doctor answers very seriously, putting down his pen, his face clearly visible.
chute: The aunt freezes with her mouth open. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the aunt's shocked face looking into the camera.

lieu: terrace of a maquis in Treichville, Abidjan, at night, a plastic table with two drinks, colorful string lights

persos.nom: the girlfriend in the sequin top
persos.desc: young woman in her 20s, silver sequin top, long box braids
persos.pose: sitting at the table, leaning toward her boyfriend's phone, smiling

persos.desc: young man in his 20s, mustard-yellow polo shirt, small goatee, holding his phone
persos.pose: sitting across the table, holding up his phone

dialogue: Chéri, tu as mis ma photo en fond d'écran ?
Oui bébé. Pour faire peur aux voleurs de téléphone dêh.
jeu: Nobody walks; both stay in their places for the whole video. The girlfriend asks sweetly, delighted. The boyfriend answers proudly and sincerely, showing the phone screen, his face clearly visible.
chute: The girlfriend's smile slowly disappears. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the girlfriend's offended face looking into the camera.

source: A7 Le docteur de chaque année
lieu: small living room in Abobo, Abidjan, two plastic chairs, a calendar on the wall, a standing fan, afternoon

persos.desc: wife in her 30s, turquoise-and-white wax blouse with a matching long skirt, holding a doctor's prescription
persos.pose: standing, holding up the prescription, happy

persos.nom: the broke husband on the plastic chair
persos.desc: husband in his 40s, faded grey t-shirt with holes, old flip-flops
persos.pose: sitting on a plastic chair, listening

dialogue: Chéri, le docteur dit que je dois manger trois fois par jour dêh.
Ya fohi. On va changer de docteur.
jeu: Nobody walks; both stay in their places for the whole video. The wife reads the prescription happily. The husband answers calmly and firmly, his face clearly visible.
chute: The wife slowly lowers the prescription. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the wife's shocked face looking into the camera.

lieu: living room of an apartment in Plateau, Abidjan, a cream sofa, a bookshelf, morning sunlight

persos.nom: the curious wife in the head tie
persos.desc: wife in her 30s, purple-and-gold head tie, ivory linen jumpsuit
persos.pose: standing behind the sofa, leaning toward her husband, curious

persos.nom: the smiling husband with the book
persos.desc: husband in his 30s, thin moustache, burgundy cardigan, reading a thick book
persos.pose: sitting on the sofa, reading a thick book and smiling

dialogue: Bébé, tu lis quel livre depuis ce matin en souriant comme ça dêh ?
Une histoire qui parle exactement de notre couple, ma chérie.
Ehh, tu es trop romantique ! C'est quoi le titre ?
jeu: Nobody walks; both stay in their places for the whole video. The wife asks, curious. The husband answers tenderly without looking up from his book. The wife is delighted. The husband answers calmly and sincerely, his face clearly visible.
chute: The wife's delighted smile slowly freezes. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the wife's offended face looking into the camera.
